  "title": "Save original events as JSON files",
  "body": "I'd like to save all room's events in their original JSON representation instead of YAML.\r\n\r\nA possible format would be one file per one day of events, where event objects are separated with newlines:\r\n\r\n```\r\n{obj1...}\r\n{obj2...}\r\n```\r\n\r\nAdvantages of this format:\r\n\r\n- good interop with JSON tooling like jq and line-based processing like grep etc\r\n- allows to render any format for viewing (html, txt, yaml etc)\r\n- likely takes less space than yaml",
